title: Kaltura Experience Components Catalog
description: A2UI 1.0 catalog for Kaltura Experience Components: Player v7, Flashcards, Media Manager, and more. Lists the A2UI basic components and functions (copied from the A2UI basic catalog), the 12 Kaltura components and the Kaltura function copyToClipboard. A surface uses one catalog, so register only this one. Refs point at common_types.json, which ships next to this file.

com_kaltura_adapters.description: Where tier-1 A2UI clients can load the renderers backing this catalog's components. Served by jsDelivr from the git tags of github.com/kaltura/kaltura-a2ui-components. Not on npm.

react.description: ESM bundle. React is an external peer. The host provides it. Register kalturaReactCatalog alone (see buildKalturaCatalog). It already holds the basic components. The module imports a second file, the SSR stub at stubCdn. Pin it with stubIntegrity too.

webcomponent.description: Self-contained IIFE (React inlined, CSS-in-JS). Drop in via <script> on plain-HTML hosts; registers all Kaltura custom elements on load. Verify with the integrity hash.

instructions:
1. Use one Kaltura component per user need. Do not rebuild a widget from basic components.
2. Never invent IDs, URLs or keys. Take partnerId, uiconfId and entryId from the user, the host or earlier tool results.
3. Media URLs must be on the host's allowed Kaltura domains. Anything else renders nothing.
4. Never put a Kaltura Session (KS) in a message. The host adds it.
5. Components that need a KS fail without a host-supplied KS. Say so to the user instead of retrying.
6. To play a manual playlist use playlistId. Set exactly one of entryId and playlistId.
7. Reply in plain text when the client does not list this catalog id.

uiconfId.description: Player (uiConf) ID. Integer, not a string, not a binding.

entryId.description: Entry to play, a string like '0_abc123'. Set exactly one of entryId and playlistId.

playlistId.description: Manual playlist to play, a string like '1_abc123'. Set exactly one of entryId and playlistId. startTime and clipTo do not apply to a playlist.

autoplay.description: Auto-start playback. Requires muted=true per browser policy. Default: false.

muted.description: Start muted. Must be true when autoplay is true. Default: false.

startTime.description: Seek to this position (seconds) on load.

entryName.description: Optional entry name shown in the player title.

entryDescription.description: Optional entry description shown under the player. HTML tags are stripped.

action.description: Optional. Tells the agent about this widget's errors and events, with fixed fields only (never the KS or remote text).

region.description: Optional. The Kaltura region of this widget's account: nvp1 (US), irp2 (EU), frp2 (DE), cap2 (CA), syp2 (AP), sgp2 (SG), or a name the host app defined. Leave it out to use the app's region. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. A region the host app does not allow is refused. sgp2 has no Unisphere host, so Genie, Media Manager, Content Lab, Agents Widget, VOD Avatar, Avatar and Captions Editor refuse it. KalturaChart.description: Kaltura Chart: 12 chart types (line, bar, area, pie, scatter, geo, wordcloud, treemap, heatmap, radar, sankey, funnel). The data is literal: to update the chart, send the component again.

chartType.description: Chart type. It sets how rows are read. line, bar, area, scatter, radar: xKey is the category, yKeys are the numeric series. pie, treemap, funnel, wordcloud, geo: yKeys[0] is the value, and rows with a value of 0 or less are dropped (wordcloud draws the top 80). geo: xKey is a country name or an ISO alpha-2 code. sankey: one row per link, xKey is the source and yKeys is [target, value]. heatmap: one row per cell, xKey is the column and yKeys is [value, row].

data.description: Rows to draw, as objects. Literal only, no data binding: to update the chart, send the component again. At most 500 rows are drawn. Row shape depends on chartType.

sourceData.description: Full dataset for table/export view when chart shows a summary subset.

title.description: Chart title displayed above the visualization.

xKey.description: Key of the x-axis or category value in each row. Default: 'name' (pie), 'text' (wordcloud), 'country' (geo), 'source' (sankey), else the first key with a non-number value.

yKeys.description: Keys of the value series. Default: every key except xKey. For pie, treemap, funnel, wordcloud, geo, sankey and heatmap the order matters. See chartType.

yLabels.description: Human-readable labels for the yKeys series (legend labels).

colors.description: Optional color overrides for chart series (hex or CSS color strings).

annotations.description: Vertical annotation markers on cartesian charts (line, bar, area, scatter).

color.description: Annotation color (hex or CSS). Default: accent color.

action.description: Optional. Tells the agent about this widget's errors and events, with fixed fields only (never the KS or remote text).

required.description: Checks that the value is not null, undefined, or empty.

formatString.description: Performs string interpolation of data model values and other functions in the catalog functions list and returns the resulting string. The value string can contain interpolated expressions in the `${expression}` format. Supported expression types include: JSON Pointer paths to the data model (e.g., `${/absolute/path}` or `${relative/path}`), and renderer-side function calls (e.g., `${now()}`). Function arguments must be named (e.g., `${formatDate(value:${/currentDate}, format:'MM-dd')}`). To include a literal `${` sequence, escape it as `\${`.

formatNumber.description: Formats a number with the specified grouping and decimal precision.

decimals.description: Optional. The number of decimal places to show. Defaults to 0 or 2 depending on locale.

grouping.description: Optional. If true, uses locale-specific grouping separators (e.g. '1,000'). If false, returns raw digits (e.g. '1000'). Defaults to true.

formatCurrency.description: Formats a number as a currency string.

decimals.description: Optional. The number of decimal places to show. Defaults to 0 or 2 depending on locale.

grouping.description: Optional. If true, uses locale-specific grouping separators (e.g. '1,000'). If false, returns raw digits (e.g. '1000'). Defaults to true.

formatDate.description: Formats a timestamp into a string using a pattern.

format.description:
A Unicode TR35 date pattern string.

Token Reference:
- Year: 'yy' (26), 'yyyy' (2026)
- Month: 'M' (1), 'MM' (01), 'MMM' (Jan), 'MMMM' (January)
- Day: 'd' (1), 'dd' (01), 'E' (Tue), 'EEEE' (Tuesday)
- Hour (12h): 'h' (1-12), 'hh' (01-12) - requires 'a' for AM/PM
- Hour (24h): 'H' (0-23), 'HH' (00-23) - Military Time
- Minute: 'mm' (00-59)
- Second: 'ss' (00-59)
- Period: 'a' (AM/PM)

Examples:
- 'MMM dd, yyyy' -> 'Jan 16, 2026'
- 'HH:mm' -> '14:30' (Military)
- 'h:mm a' -> '2:30 PM'
- 'EEEE, d MMMM' -> 'Friday, 16 January'

pluralize.description: Returns a localized string based on the Common Locale Data Repository (CLDR) plural category of the count (zero, one, two, few, many, other). Requires an 'other' fallback. For English, just use 'one' and 'other'.

value.description: The numeric value used to determine the plural category.

two.description: String for the 'two' category (used in Arabic, Welsh, etc.).

few.description: String for the 'few' category (e.g., small groups in Slavic languages).

many.description: String for the 'many' category (e.g., large groups in various languages).

other.description: The default/fallback string (used for general plural cases).

or.description: Performs a logical OR operation on a list of boolean values.

not.description: Performs a logical NOT operation on a boolean value.

copyToClipboard.description: Copies the text to the clipboard. Does nothing for empty text. This function has no return value.
